Enrich eLTER site iNaturalist occurrences with EU directive legal information

Source: R/functions.R
add_eunis_legal_to_occ.Rd

Iterates over all unique taxon.id values in the occurrence tibble and enriches each row with EU directive information retrieved from the BISE (Biodiversity Information System for Europe) REST API via get_eunis_legal_info.

For each taxon the function appends the directive name and the Annex identifier (II, IV, V for Habitats; I for Birds). When a species is listed under both directives the occurrence tibble will contain multiple rows for that taxon – one per directive/annex entry.

Usage

add_eunis_legal_to_occ(occ_eLTER)

Arguments

occ_eLTER

An sf tibble of iNaturalist occurrences, typically output of ReLTER::get_site_speciesOccurrences() after add_iucn_to_occ and add_nativeness_to_occ.

Value

The input tibble enriched with:

directive

EU directive name ("Habitats Directive (92/43/EEC)", "Birds Directive (2009/147/EC)"), or NA.

annex

Short annex code (e.g. "II", "IV", "I"), or NA.

Note

EU directive data are retrieved live from the BISE REST API (https://biodiversity.europa.eu) using two POST requests per unique taxon. An internet connection is required. The function includes a short delay between taxa (Sys.sleep(0.2)) to avoid overloading the server.

See also

get_eunis_legal_info, obs_pie_chart

Author

Alessandro Oggioni, PhD alessandro.oggioni@cnr.it

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
deimsid       <- "https://deims.org/6b62feb2-61bf-47e1-b97f-0e909c408db8"
site_boundary <- ReLTER::get_site_info(deimsid = deimsid)

iNat_occ <- ReLTER::get_site_speciesOccurrences(
  deimsid  = deimsid,
  list_DS  = "inat",
  show_map = TRUE,
  limit    = 50
)

occ_legal <- iNat_occ$inat |>
  add_iucn_to_occ() |>
  add_nativeness_to_occ(country = site_boundary$country) |>
  add_eunis_legal_to_occ()
} # }
